title: fix(service-analytics)!: the analytics admission bridge answers 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, not a denial's 403, when the security service is missing or unusable
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBKyGxNYJyVxQVGvyziBNBD)_

Refs #25561

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This is the ruling-A follow-up on the closed card: ruling record 6384696061 (letter **A**, maintainer 「25561 同意」). Claim 6384855135, premise amendment 6384944476. PR #25595 landed the card itself; this PR does not close it.

## What was wrong

`AnalyticsServicePlugin` bridges the object-level read admission (`admitObjectRead`) to the `security` service. Its UNUSABLE branch covers three cases: resolving the service threw, the service exposes neither `canReadObject` nor `explain`, or (on `ObjectKernel` and `LiteKernel`, whose synchronous `getService` throws on a miss) no `security` service was ever registered. That branch answered `return false`. So the caller got `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, the same bytes as a real denial, although no verdict was reached. After PR #25595 it was the last analytics read gate where a fault was answered as a denial. Its `error` log line also said "A security service is wired on this deployment". That sentence is false when no security service was ever registered.

## What changed

- **`plugin.ts`, the object-level bridge.** The UNUSABLE branch now throws `readAdmissionUnresolvedError(object)`, the shared constructor PR #25595 added in `read-admission.ts`. `assertObjectsReadable` relays it as `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / `503` with `object` naming the object. The message names only the object; the cause stays in the server log. Fail-closed is unchanged: the query is refused before any read.
- **Real denials are byte-unchanged.** `canReadObject` or `explain` answering false still returns `false`, and the caller still gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. The ABSENT branch (a context that answers the lookup with nothing admits and warns once) is untouched, as the ruling leaves it unruled.
- **The log line.** The object-level bridge's `error` line now says the `security` service is missing or cannot be used, so no verdict was reached, and analytics refuses rather than fall open. That is true for both the broken and the never-registered case. The row-level read scope bridge in the same file printed the same false sentence for the same two cases. It now says that analytics does not serve rows with no row-level policy when the `security` service is missing or cannot be used. That bridge's answer (`READ_SCOPE_COMPILE_FAILED`) does not change.
- **Doc comments** that called the never-registered answer a denial are respelled to `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503: the bridge block and the [#22235] declaration in `plugin.ts`, the fail-direction list in `read-admission.ts`, `AnalyticsServiceConfig.admitObjectRead` and `assertReadAdmitted` in `analytics-service.ts`, and `scripts/analytics-reconcile/boot.ts`. No ADR text states the status, so no `docs/adr/**` edit is needed.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch, with a BREAKING banner (a status on the wire moves), the migration, both declaration lines and the ADR-0087 disposition, in the same form as PR #25595.

## The pins that moved (403 to 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with `object`)

| file | case |
|---|---|
| `admission-bridge-resolution.test.ts` | resolving `security` throws |
| `admission-bridge-resolution.test.ts` | the service exposes neither `canReadObject` nor `explain` |
| `admission-bridge-resolution.test.ts` | a real `ObjectKernel` / `LiteKernel` that never registers `security` (two runs) |
| `admission-absence-report.test.ts` | a real `LiteKernel` with no security service |
| `read-scope-bridge-resolution.test.ts` | a throwing resolver with both auto-bridges live. The premise read did not list this one; the whole-package run found it. |

The real-verdict cases (`canReadObject` false, `explain` allowed false, a later-registered service answering false) stay at `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. The log regexes still match the corrected text and were kept.

`packages/rest`: no seam pin of this branch. `analytics-read-gate-fault-envelope.test.ts` injects its own `admitObjectRead` and never reaches the bridge. The rest door tests that boot the plugin either wire a security service or assert no status on this path. No `packages/rest` source change: the dataset door already relays a declared 5xx (PR #25595).

## Tests

Final head `032ae18225`. It differs from `24895888` only by a merge of `origin/main` (#25658, which touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` and `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`). The `service-analytics` tree is byte-identical between the two.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test` at `24895888`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 185 passed (185), Tests 4517 passed, 262 skipped (4779). The first run, before the row-scope pin moved, was red on exactly that pin: 1 failed, 184 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 7 changed source files: exit 0.
- Dogfood battery (owed by the `!` title) at `032ae18225`, closure built under the lock (command-exit 0): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 293 passed, 3 skipped (296), Tests 2509 passed, 18 skipped (2527).

## Ablation (one leg per changed negative pin)

Done with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix. The anchor `throw readAdmissionUnresolvedError(object);` was replaced by `return false;`: anchor x1 to x0, blob `83715b24c049` to `0e7c50c8c5b1`. The tests import `../plugin.js` from source, so no dist was involved. The three files were then run:

```
× refuses a throwing resolver with BOTH auto-bridges live (no door falls open)
× REFUSES 503 when resolving the "security" service THROWS
× REFUSES 503 when the "security" service exposes neither canReadObject nor explain
× REFUSES the dataset query 503, ... (ObjectKernel)
× REFUSES the dataset query 503, ... (LiteKernel)
× logs no init-time WARN, and absence stays loud at query time with the outcome unchanged
-   "code": "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
+   "code": "PERMISSION_DENIED",
-   "status": 503,
+   "status": 403,
Test Files  3 failed (3) · Tests  6 failed | 12 passed (18)
```

Restore: blob after restore `83715b24c049` == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The same three files then ran green: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 18 passed (18). The 12 that stayed green under the mutation include every real-denial 403 pin, so those pins did not move.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `032ae18225` derived 82 commands. All 82 were run; each record is `cmd :: exit N`, and every one exited 0. `--ran` verdict: "82 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 82 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". On the earlier run at `24895888`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no `dist/`) and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` could not read its pinned fixture on the shallow clone. Both exited 0 at the final head, after the dogfood closure build and a fetch of the fixture commit. CI runs the full farm.

## Acceptance notes

- The object-level bridge now logs two `error` lines per refused query on this path: its own line, carrying the cause, and `assertObjectsReadable`'s catch line ("read-admission resolution failed …"). That second line is the same one every throwing provider already gets. Not changed here.
- After landing, the seat posts the dated note on #22235 (ruling step 5). This PR does not post it.
